text_block_list.text:
So... my d-d-debut is finally here. I'm a
little
nervous, but...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото
Мэйсё Дото
choice_data_list: You're fired up all of a sudden.

text_block_list.text:
Well, it all started after the three of us
went to
the Derby. I realized I can't
afford to stay the
same!
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
I need to change. Once my debut is
over, I'll
become a different me. So,
that's why I... I, I'b
bleeb in melf—
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото
choice_data_list: Slow down. You're muddying your words.

text_block_list.text:
Huh? Oh, I'm sorry... My heart is beating
so fast...
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
I promise to put on a great run. Trainer,
Opera O,
will you two watch me?
text_block_list.name: Мэйсё Дото

text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'm pleased by your enthusiasm.
Now go
forth, Doto!
text_block_list.name: Т.М. Опера О

text_block_list.text:
Was that a reply or a very unique battle
cry?
Either way, I have confidence in her!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
